# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** 14-15  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P55](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0055), [v2 c29 P4](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea / Prince Edward Island area  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden / Maid for Miss Lavendar Lewis  <sub>[v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a freckled face with a snub nose and a mouth so wide it seems to stretch from ear to ear. Her long fair hair is worn in two braids tied with enormous blue ribbon bows. Though she considers herself not as handsome as others, she has a very wide and cheerful smile.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Charlotta the Fourth is a brisk, hard-working, and intensely loyal handmaiden who deeply adores her mistress, Miss Lavendar, and Anne Shirley. She is somewhat literal-minded and prone to dramatic worries, yet she possesses a generous, affectionate nature and a strong sense of duty. Though occasionally self-conscious about her looks or lack of poise, she takes immense pride in her work and in the happiness of those she serves.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c21 P50](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0050), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)_

- Loyal and devoted  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- Brisk and industrious  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping and cooking assistance  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
- Basting and sewing aid  <sub>[v2 c29 P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve and care for Miss Lavendar faithfully  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- To learn to move, speak, and act like Anne Shirley  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

## History

Leonora Bowman became the fourth of her sisters to serve as Miss Lavendar Lewis's maid at Echo Lodge when she was thirteen years old, taking on the customary household name of 'Charlotta the Fourth.' When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon Echo Lodge, Charlotta welcomed them and assisted in entertaining the guests. She formed a deep admiration for Anne, secretly trying to imitate her manners and posture. She served as a faithful helper during the reunion and courtship of Miss Lavendar and Stephen Irving, anxiously helping with wedding preparations. Following Miss Lavendar's marriage to Mr. Irving, Charlotta accompanied them to Boston to continue living with them.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P38](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0038), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003), [v2 c30 P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012), [v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)_

## Background by volume

- Real name is Leonora, born into the Bowman family  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- The fourth sister in her family to work as Miss Lavendar's maid, earning her the name 'Charlotta the Fourth'  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
- Hired at age thirteen to live at Echo Lodge for board and clothes  <sub>[v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044)</sub>
